page.layout: One printed page: digitiser's cover sheet. Top right logo; centred title block; below a rule, a licence and terms-of-use block in small type; bottom right a Visual Library logo. Only the title block and licence text are printed matter; the logos are digitiser furniture and are left out.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet for e-rara.ch, not the book's own title page. Its printed matter is the title block (website, book title, author, place and year, library, shelf mark, persistent link) and the multilingual terms-of-use notice. Logos are omitted as digitiser furniture. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
